name: Sold Out on You
description: A work-obsessed cosmetics CEO and a top home-shopping host struggling with insomnia cross paths, and through an unexpected romance, begin to heal the emptiness in their lives.

credits_cast.character: Song Hak Daek / Yang Sang Geum
credits_cast.name: Goh Doo-shim

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Dam Ye-jin's shopping host career is on the rise — until she loses her primetime slot. Determined to find a new hit item, she heads to the countryside.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Ye-jin realizes farmer Matthew Lee may be able to help her. But her efforts to persuade him prove futile, until she bumps into the perfect opportunity.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Strange phone calls keeps Matthew up at night. Meanwhile, Eric Seo and Ye-jin double down on their plans to get Matthew to work with L'Étoile again.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: When crisis hits the farm, Ye-jin improvises a way to help. Matthew starts to see Ye-jin in a different light after a surprisingly close encounter.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Matthew and Ye-jin make a pact to work together. When Matthew discovers some pressing information, Ye-jin is forced to make an important choice.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: As Ye-jin deals with the fallout of her decision, Matthew invites her to Deokpung Village to get her mind off things — and be his temporary roommate.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Everyone gathers in the village, sparking new realizations and emotions. Ye-jin confronts Matthew about the mixed signals he's been giving her.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: With their feelings revealed, Matthew and Ye-jin explore their new relationship. But secrets from the past start to threaten their newfound happiness.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: After coming clean about his past, Matthew pushes Ye-jin away. But keeping a distance gets harder when Ye-jin learns about her late-night calls.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Matthew gets jealous when he learns that Eric is Ye-jin's new neighbor. Sparks fly in the village, keeping spirits high — until someone goes missing.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Matthew enlists Ye-jin's help to develop a new skincare cream. Everything looks promising — until a smear campaign triggers an attack on the village.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: With the truth behind the scandal from five years ago revealed, Matthew and Ye-jin prepare for their home shopping launch. Will they be able to sell out?
